author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
There are two types of jobs they will be disrupted differently in the AI revolution

Type A - man vs. nature

if your job is to make something real, whether it is to make something faster, more power efficient, find cures to diseases, invent new material, AI will be your best friend.  We can always push the physical limit slightly further.

Type B - man vs man

if you job is a zero sum game, like advertising, most of pure money grabbing business.  It is just an AI arm race with your competitors.  If you don't use AI, you lose.  But if everyone use AI, it won't generate any new gains, just redistribute to different winners and losers
